question: Two resistors of 6 Ω and 4 Ω in series combination are connected to a 12 V battery. The effective current of the circuit will be:
solution:
The correct answer is**__ 1.2 Amp.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Given R₁ = 6 Ω 

 R2 = 4 Ω in series combination, V= 12 volt I=? 

**According to Ohm's law= V = IR** 

 Being in series combination resistance will be R₁ + R₂ = 6 Ω +4 Ω = 10 Ω 

 12 = I (10 Ω )

12/10 = I

Effective current (I) = 1.2 Ampere.
